user.title: Add a WT101 thermostat
user.description:
Set the name and limits. Credentials are inherited from the parent application.

Use **Follow target temperature from** to let a thermostat or helper set the target.

The WT101 uplink sensors are only shown for TTN hubs: there they bring the WT101's own readings into HA. ChirpStack hubs get these directly from the webhook.

data.name: Name
data.external_timeout: External sensor: timeout on the WT101 (min)
data.external_offline_mode: External sensor: when readings stop arriving
data.setpoint_priority: Setpoint: when the knob is turned

data_description.external_temp_sensor: Used only while the "external sensor mode" switch is on. The WT101 then regulates the valve on this temperature instead of its built-in sensor.
data_description.external_send_interval: How often HA pushes the reading. Set this to (at least) the WT101 reporting interval: downlinks are only delivered on the next uplink, so a shorter interval makes the queue grow. ChirpStack hubs with the webhook push once per uplink automatically.
data_description.external_timeout: If the WT101 receives no reading for this long (3–60 min) it applies the fallback below. Must be longer than the send interval.
data_description.external_offline_mode: What the WT101 does after the timeout.
data_description.setpoint_source: A thermostat (climate: its target temperature is used), input_number, number or sensor whose value becomes the WT101 target temperature. Replaces an automation that sets the climate target: HA only sends when the value really changes and waits for the device to confirm, so LoRaWAN delays cannot cause a loop.
data_description.setpoint_priority: What happens when someone changes the target on the knob itself.
data_description.setpoint_grace: How long HA waits for an uplink confirming a new target before retrying. About 2× the WT101 reporting interval plus a margin. ChirpStack hubs with the webhook confirm after 2 uplinks already.
data_description.current_temp_sensor: Only for TTN or other integrations: the sensor holding the temperature the WT101 itself reports. Leave empty for ChirpStack with the webhook.
data_description.target_temp_sensor: Not for picking a thermostat — use "Follow target temperature from" for that. This is the sensor holding the target the WT101 itself reports (e.g. from TTN). Leave empty for ChirpStack with the webhook.

device.title: Pick the thermostat device
device.description: WT101 devices are listed first (matched on Milesight brand and WT101 model in TTN, or "WT101" in the ChirpStack device profile name). Pick a device or choose Manual entry.

manual.title: Manual device id
manual.description: Type the TTN device ID or ChirpStack device EUI.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure thermostat
reconfigure.description:
Update this thermostat. The bound LoRaWAN device cannot be changed here — remove and re-add the thermostat to swap devices.

On ChirpStack hubs a WT101 uplink sensor is only shown while it is still set; clear it to remove it (the webhook supplies the data).
